title: Google Fi debuts a "super network" feature for automatic carrier switching and Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ to improve indoor connectivity in malls, airports, and more (Sam Rutherford/Engadget)
summary: Sam Rutherford / Engadget: Google Fi debuts a “super network” feature for automatic carrier switching and Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ to improve indoor connectivity in malls, airports, and more — It's rolling out first on Pixel phones before wider availability arrives in 2027. — Getting the fastest mobile data speeds …
